notes: Operating temperature 0°C to +70°C (TQ2031-TUNC-SO) and -40°C to +85°C (TQ2031-TUNI-SO); storage -40°C to +85°C. Typical reach unamplified 120 km (footnote 1: limited by power budget); amplified 120 km (footnote 2: limited by dispersion compensation); 300 km (footnote 3: Extended mode). Dispersion tolerance ±2400 ps/nm and ±6000 ps/nm (footnote 3 Extended mode, set through host in Low Power mode). Power budget 0–30 dB. Extended mode increases worst-case power by 0.2 W (TQ2031-TUNI-SO) or 0.3 W (TQ2031-TUNC-SO). Footnote 4: average power for Tx/Rx power specs. Footnote 5: receiver sensitivity unamplified at OSNR >35 dB/0.1 nm. Footnote 6: 100G DQPSK SC-FEC for -30.0 dBm and 16.5 dB/0.1 nm OSNR tolerance. Footnote 7: 100G DQPSK RS-FEC for -24.0 dBm and 21.5 dB/0.1 nm OSNR tolerance. Footnote 8: extended range amplified -22 dBm with <1 dB OSNR penalty relative to Rx OSNR tolerance limit. Tx OSNR in-band/out-of-band stated at 12.5 GHz; Rx OSNR tolerance at 0.1 nm. Tx output monitor range -2 dBm to +4 dBm. Rx power monitor: signal -21 dBm to +3 dBm, total -21 dBm to +6 dBm. Media FEC latency SC-FEC 24 µs, RS-FEC 5 µs.
